hero.title: Record Bible translations in your own language
hero.subtitle: Work with your team, passage by passage, with your voice. No internet needed for weeks.

features.title: Made for teams in remote places
features.subtitle: Record, check and approve oral Bible translations together.

record.title: Record by cards
record.description: Speak a passage. LangQuest splits your voice into small cards you can re-record or reorder.

review.title: Review and approve
review.description: Your team checks each passage in steps you choose. Everyone sees what is approved and what is waiting.

offline.title: Works offline
offline.description: Record for a month without a connection. Your work syncs when you reach the internet.

team.title: Invite your team
team.description: Send an invitation by link or QR code. Each person gets a role.

howItWorks.title: How LangQuest works
howItWorks.subtitle: Three steps, from a blank language to approved audio.

organize.title: Set up your organization
organize.description: Add your languages and choose the books and passages to translate.

record.title: Record passages
record.description: Listen to the source, then speak the passage in your language.

review.title: Check and approve
review.description: Reviewers listen, give feedback and approve. Coordinators see progress for every language.

roles.title: A job for everyone on the team
roles.subtitle: Each person sees the work that is theirs.

translators.title: Translators
translators.description: Record your passages and see which ones need more work.

reviewers.title: Reviewers
reviewers.description: Listen, check and approve passages, alone or with other reviewers.

coordinators.title: Coordinators
coordinators.description: Invite people, assign roles and follow progress across languages.

cta.title: Join the LangQuest community
cta.subtitle: Get news about LangQuest Next and help bring Scripture to more languages.
cta.notification: We'll notify you when LangQuest is ready for beta testing.

portal.title: Using the original LangQuest?
portal.subtitle: Manage your existing translation projects in the portal.
